item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 14:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

The University of Padua, pursuant to Article 24-bis of Law 30 December 2010, no. 240, and the National Collective Bargaining Agreement of 19 April 2018, insofar as applicable, hereby announces the Public Competition No. 2026S30. The competition, based on examinations, is intended to recruit No. 1 First-level Research Technologist (“EP1” pay grade), who will be hired under a fixed-term, full-time employment contract for 24 months at the Department of Physics and Astronomy “Galileo Galilei” - DFA. The Research Technologist will be assigned to the Coordination Office for Specialized Technical and Laboratory Activities, “Legnaro Multidisciplinary Physics” Research Laboratories Sector - DFA.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/ICHI-02 Impianti e processi industriali chimici

LANDFEED – Transforming Waste into Sustainable Biofertilisers is a Horizon Europe project aimed at transforming agri-food, forestry and urban waste and by-products into biofertilisers through targeted technologies and circular solutions. The project is structured around five Use Cases: UC1 (Spain): transformation of HORECA food waste into biofertiliser through solid-state fermentation using filamentous fungal strains; UC2 (France): transformation of animal-derived residues into biofertiliser through twin-screw extrusion and enzymatic hydrolysis; UC3 (Greece): Transformation of olive residues into fertilising ash through biomass combustion drying with integrated CO₂ capture; UC4 (Italy):…

item.title: Tecnologo: Multidisciplinary data collection and processing for the environmental management of Mediterranean microtidal beaches (Univ. CAGLIARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-17 23:59
Institution: Univ. CAGLIARI, Cagliari

The technologist will be involved in the acquisition, processing, and management of topographic, aerial photogrammetric, hydroacoustic, sedimentological, geomorphological, and coastal video-monitoring data for the management and monitoring of Mediterranean microtidal beaches. The technologist will also be involved in the setup and ongoing maintenance of digital databases, as well as the updating and management of data for the early warning system for coastal flooding and the forecasting of marine risks from storm surges and rip currents.
